context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog Minion fully tested. All endpoints working: /api/catalog/stats, /api/catalog/items (CRUD), /api/catalog/categories (CRUD), /api/catalog/variant-groups (CRUD), /api/catalog/duplicates (scan and resolve), /api/catalog/import-from-intake, /api/catalog/export/woo-csv, /api/catalog/items/{id}/normalize. LLM normalization uses GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM key and takes 15-30 seconds. Duplicate detection uses rapidfuzz library. Default 14 categories are seeded on first access. Woo export changes item status from Ready to Exported. Frontend has 3 pages: CatalogDashboard, CatalogItemEditor, DuplicateReview.

stats_endpoint.response: total_items, by_status, draft_count, needs_review_count, ready_count, exported_count, category_count, variant_group_count

items_crud.list: GET /api/catalog/items - supports status, category_id, search filters

categories_crud.delete: DELETE /api/catalog/categories/{id} - blocked if items use it

import_export.export: GET /api/catalog/export/woo-csv?status=Ready - exports as CSV, marks items as Exported

normalize.effect: Updates title, brand, descriptions, tags, attributes, category; changes status from Draft to Needs Review

frontend_pages.CatalogDashboard: /catalog - stats, search, filters, item list, action buttons
frontend_pages.DuplicateReview: /catalog/duplicates - threshold selector, pair list, resolve actions

llm_integration.output: Normalized product data with category suggestion and variant hints
